svg.title: How S0 reads S1’s hand intent
svg.desc: Hand and cube poses from a fixed-wrist replay, the actual hand and its virtual requested pose overlaid with an angle plot, and desired finger loads beside measured force directions on the cube. S0 reads the three streams and live feedback.
svg.metadata: Geometry: h1-cube-bank-contact-dynamics-v7/run002/06-baseline.npz. First H30 endpoint native step 1520, middle 1660, last 1810. Saved native qpos, same wrist; virtual hand uses issued_next[165], separate from applied_qPD. Arrows use solver step 1660 object-contact positions and signed world-space forces exerted on the cube, rendered with pre-step qpos[1658]. Finger arrows only. Shared scale 0.033 m/N before perspective projection. Heatmap is an illustrative desired load change. Camera views are nominal observer views.

g.text: How S0 reads S1’s hand intent
Future hand shape, shown with the cube it moves.
Brown arrow: face normal. Angle relative to k1 in the palm frame.
Solid hand: actual pose. Violet outline: upstream requested pose.
S1 specifies load changes. Contact forces arise during execution.
Feedback: joint motion, applied control, optional touch
MuJoCo replay with an illustrative desired force map.
